title: SIGNET — Episode 1: The Return of the Bearer
synopsis: The first episode of the Penalver Universe fantasy-action series SIGNET.

audienceReactions.quote: Bro, what a gem you put together with this Chapter One! The atmosphere and production are on another level. Get moving on Chapter II — we already want to see how The Bearer's journey continues. Cheers and success with this cinematic universe!
audienceReactions.author: @DanicaCarranza-e4u

audienceReactions.quote: This is bad news for the big movie studios — the quality of this short is excellent. I never thought AI productions would evolve this fast and with this much quality. Great work behind the keyboard. Congratulations!! Looking forward to the sequel.
audienceReactions.author: @giorgiomafi

audienceReactions.quote: Excellent — when's the rest of the chapters coming? Unleashed the Mr. Wick energy.
audienceReactions.author: @lorddmoises
